action.description: show puts items in front of the user. focus_tab returns to an open Bench tab. close closes the Bench, only when the user asks.

items.description: Only for show. What to show, in display order. Each item has exactly one of path, resource, or object.

path.description: Existing local file: a workspace-relative path, absolute path, file:// URL, or ~/ path. Paths outside the workspace ask the user for permission. Never invent a path.

resource.description: Prepared reading resource id or alias, copied from the resource list or prepare_resource. Never invent one.

object.description: Buddy object id copied from an earlier tool result.

where.description: Only for show. Where images, video, and audio appear. Defaults to inline. Ignored for anything that can display in only one place.

tabKey.description: Only for focus_tab. Exact tab key from the turn context or bench_read_context, such as a file tab or a Browser tab (browser:...).
